concept: Heritage butcher-shop palette evoking a classic, premium meat market: a deep butcher-red/maroon primary anchors the brand with hearty trustworthiness, a warm gold accent adds an artisanal, premium gleam, dark espresso-brown ink reads like hand-stamped butcher's lettering, and creamy butcher-paper backgrounds keep the experience warm, traditional, and inviting.
contrastNotes: All required ratios hold against the creamy butcher-paper bg (#F7F1E3, L=0.882). Ink #2B1D14 on bg = 14.5:1 (>=7:1). Ink-soft #7A5C45 on bg = 5.4:1 (>=4.5:1). White on primary #8E2A20 = 8.4:1 (>=4.5:1). Primary #8E2A20 on bg = 7.5:1 (>=3:1). Bonus: ink on surface #FFFCF5 = 15.9:1; primary-dark #6E1E16 carries white at 11.4:1 for hover/active states; warm gold accent #C9961F is used for decorative gleam/dividers, not body text, on dark primary/secondary fields.
